items.summary: A humanoid has infinitely many ways to stand up from sitting while maintaining balance, making sit-to-stand (STS) a challenging control problem. We synthesise natural humanoid STS motion from scratch using reinforcement learning, without demonstrations or reference trajectories. A single Proximal Policy Optimisation policy learns smooth, human-like rising driven by three complementary components. (i) A coupled force/chair-height curriculum is used. A vertical pelvis-assist force aids early trajectory exploration and decays over training. Taller chairs are unlocked with decaying assisting force. This ensures that the policy masters a viable STS trajectory at each chair height before being exposed to harder ones, avoiding the premature distribution shift that otherwise collapses generalisation. (ii) Motion robustness is achieved by randomly sampling from a large number of inverse kinematics-generated initial and target poses spanning over eight chair heights. (iii) A set of rewards is defined inspired from biomechanics and optimal control studies. They shape the robot's angular momentum for seat-off, and enable support-region transition via centre of pressure attraction function to ensure smooth low-effort actuation. On a deterministic force-free evaluator, the policy attains more than 97% balanced-standing success across eight chair heights. The policy generalises smooth motion across chair heights and enables the robot to rise from substantially deep-seated postures as compared to the state of the art.
items.summary_zh: 仿人机器人在保持平衡的情况下从坐姿站起有无穷多种方式，这使得坐起（STS）成为一个具有挑战性的控制问题。我们使用强化学习从零开始合成自然的仿人坐起动作，无需示范或参考轨迹。一个单一的近端策略优化（PPO）策略通过三个互补组件学习平滑、类人的起身动作。（i）使用耦合力/椅高课程。垂直骨盆辅助力用于早期轨迹探索，并在训练过程中逐渐衰减。较高的椅子随辅助力衰减而解锁。这确保了策略在每个椅高下都能掌握可行的坐起轨迹，然后才接触更难的任务，避免了过早的分布偏移导致泛化失败。（ii）通过从大量逆运动学生成的初始和目标姿态中随机采样实现运动鲁棒性，涵盖八个椅高。（iii）定义了一组受生物力学和最优控制研究启发的奖励函数。它们塑造机器人用于离座的角动量，并通过压力中心吸引函数实现支撑区域过渡，以确保平滑的低能耗驱动。在确定性的无外力评估器上，该策略在八个椅高上达到超过 97% 的平衡站立成功率。该策略可在不同椅高间泛化平滑运动，并使机器人能够从比现有技术显著更深的坐姿中起身。

items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreak attacks that progressively manipulate conversation context. Existing certified robustness methods are limited to single-turn inputs; naive multi-turn composition yields bounds that degrade exponentially in the number of turns. We introduce Multi-Turn Certified Robustness (MTCR), a framework that models conversational safety via State-Adversarial MDPs and defines $k$-turn certified robustness as the worst-case safety probability across $k$ adversarial turns. MTCR comprises: (i) compositional certification via embedding-space mode decomposition, yielding tighter certified lower bounds than naive multiplication; (ii) $(α,β)$-safety persistence, improving the degradation rate from $\underline{p}^{k}$ to $β^k$ (with $β> \underline{p}$) and yielding interpretable horizon estimates; (iii) matching information-theoretic upper bounds establishing tightness; and (iv) a unified algorithm combining these results. Experiments on six LLMs under $ε$-bounded and Crescendo-style attacks confirm that empirical safety consistently exceeds the certified bounds.
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）易遭受多轮越狱攻击，攻击者逐步操控对话上下文。现有的认证鲁棒性方法仅限于单轮输入；朴素的多轮组合得到的界随轮数呈指数级退化。我们提出多轮认证鲁棒性（MTCR）框架，通过状态对抗MDP建模对话安全性，并将 $k$ 轮认证鲁棒性定义为跨 $k$ 个对抗轮的最坏情况安全概率。MTCR包含：(i) 通过嵌入空间模式分解的组合式认证，给出比朴素乘法更紧的认证下界；(ii) $(α,β)$-安全持久性，将退化速率从 $\underline{p}^{k}$ 改善为 $β^k$（其中 $β> \underline{p}$），并给出可解释的轮次范围估计；(iii) 给出匹配的信息论上界以确立紧度；(iv) 一套统一算法，综合运用以上结果。在六种LLM上于 $ε$-有界攻击及Crescendo风格攻击下进行的实验表明，实证安全性始终高于认证界。
items.title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence
items.title_zh: 基于组合界与安全持久性的LLM安全多轮鲁棒性认证

# Isaac Lab 3.0 Beta 2 - Patch 1

This is a small patch release on top of the previous Isaac Lab 3.0.0 Beta 2 release, including an update to support Isaac Sim 6.0.1, which includes fixes and improvements for NuRec workflows (https://docs.isaacsim.omniverse.nvidia.com/6.0.1/overview/release_notes.html). Additionally, some fixes were introduced for Isaac Lab dependencies and docker image to better support compatibility with Isaac Sim.

## What's Changed
* Bump h5py version to >=3.16.0 by @peterd-NV in https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab/pull/6266
* Updates Isaac Sim to version 6.0.1 by @kellyguo11 in https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab/pull/6277
* [Fix] Cherry-pick Isaac Sim 6.0 streaming crash fix by @hujc7 in https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab/pull/6295


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab/compare/v3.0.0-beta2...v3.0.0-beta2.patch1

items.details: OpenVLA is a 7B-parameter vision-language-action model trained on the Open X-Embodiment dataset. The release ships Libero + BridgeData evals, fine-tuning recipes, and ONNX export. Now used as a baseline in >40 downstream papers.
items.name: OpenVLA
items.summary: OpenVLA 提供 1B-34B 参数范围的视觉-语言-动作模型训练与微调代码库，基于 PyTorch FSDP 与 Flash-Attention。旗舰 openvla-7b 由 DINOv2+SigLIP 视觉骨干 + Llama-2 LLM 构成，在 970K 轨迹（Open-X Magic Soup++）上预训练；OFT 微调方案较原版推理加速 25-50 倍。在 LIBERO 四套基准上微调版取得平均 76.5% 成功率，超过 Diffusion Policy 与 Octo。支持 BridgeData V2 真实 WidowX 机械臂评估，Apache 2.0 许可。

items.details: openpi is the official open-source release of π₀ / π₀-FAST / π₀.5 from Physical Intelligence. Weights are gated via physicalintelligence.company/research but evaluation code, training scripts, and Libero configs are Apache-2.0. Major downstream labs use this as the SOTA VLA baseline.
items.name: openpi (π₀)
items.summary: Physical Intelligence 发布的开源模型与训练仓库，包含 π0（流式 VLA，基于 PaliGemma）、π0-FAST（自回归 VLA + FAST 动作 tokenizer）、π0.5（开放世界泛化升级版，知识隔离训练）三类基础模型，均基于 1 万+ 小时机器人数据预训练。附 π0.5-LIBERO 检查点（LIBERO SOTA 性能）、π0-DROID/π0-FAST-DROID 微调流程、ALOHA 仿真+真实平台与 UR5 微调示例，并提供 Libero 与 DROID Docker 化评估脚本、OpenVLA 转换工具、远程推理 websocket 接口。

items.details: Minor release addressing sim-to-real parity gaps with MuJoCo. Adds bit-exact determinism via torch deterministic-algorithms toggle, contact-patch multi-contact support, and PyTorch prerelease builds.
items.name: Genesis
items.summary: Genesis 仿真器 v1.3.3 (2026-08-13) 修复刚体求解器在不同朝向/尺度下的收敛回归，并新增 use_deterministic_algorithms 选项以实现机器内的 bit-exact 可复现。MuJoCo 兼容模式扩展至原生 contact patch 多接触面（通过 RigidOptions.enable_contact_patch 启用）；其他修复包括 generic 与 GPU-only 求解器间的物理差异、MuJoCo 兼容模式下丢弃/后端依赖接触、解析球-球碰撞、Quadrants 1.3.0 升级；清理废弃的 compile_kernels 构建参数，并支持 PyTorch 预发布构建。
